result.reason: The operative language substantially reaches the preferred position: it provides Vendor defence and indemnity for third-party IP, legal-compliance, Vendor-caused data-security, and gross-negligence/wilful-misconduct claims, protects Customer affiliates, and includes notice, defence control, and cooperation procedures. No broader Customer indemnity is introduced. The change is otherwise targeted and preserves the existing termination and risk-allocation language. Drafting quality is reduced because Section 9.3's acknowledged reference to nonexistent Section 20.5 remains unfixed, the data-breach limb covers only unauthorised access or disclosure rather than all data-breach events, and the procedure lacks customary settlement-consent and late-notice/prejudice protections.
